title: There's more than one type of tummy tuck

title: What is a brachioplasty procedure?
excerpt: Brachioplasty, or arm lift, is a cosmetic surgery to reshape the upper arm. During the procedure, a surgeon removes fat and may reshape droopy or sagging skin.

title: What is dermabrasion?
excerpt: Dermabrasion is a surgical procedure that involves the use of a scraping tool to improve the appearance of the skin. Doctors may use it to treat scars from acne, fine wrinkles, and precancerous skin patches.

title: What to expect during recovery from breast augmentation surgery
excerpt: The American Society of Plastic Surgeons notes that breast augmentation surgery takes several weeks for full recovery. title: Worried about surgery scars? Here are some tips
